rows.grounds: first member of descriptive compound with varṇo
second member forming śyāmavarṇaḥ, describing nārāyaṇaḥ

items.question: What color and navel attribute characterize Nārāyaṇa in this description?
premises: A wheel is located in Nārāyaṇa's navel.
That navel wheel is described as raised.
items.inference: Nārāyaṇa is identified by a dark complexion and a raised wheel in the navel.
items.plain_english: Nārāyaṇa is dark-colored and has a raised wheel in his navel.
